title: 581. Longest Uncommon Subsequence II

examples.explanation: All three strings have length 3 and none is a subsequence of another, so 3 is achievable.
"aaa" is not a subsequence of "aa", while "aa" is a subsequence of "aaa".
Every string is a subsequence of another identical one.

hints: Only full strings from the array can be optimal: any proper subsequence of strs[i] that is missing elsewhere is also missed by the whole strs[i] comparison logic, so test each strs[i] itself.
Check strs[i] against every other strs[j] with a linear subsequence scan; keep the longest length that fails everywhere.
